name: Mörtfors - Getterum - Getgölen. Tjustleden etapp 1
description: Mörtfors to Getgölen. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official Swedish pages use Mörtfors and Getgölen; slugs and app IDs use Mortfors/Getgolen without diacritics.
Vastervik Outdoor/Naturkartan says 'Grön - enkel'; Vastervik municipality says 'Mestadels lätt'.
Older/basic official facts mention shelters at start and end; 2026 advice and municipality page add the mid-stage ArkNat shelter at Tällsjön.
Older Etapp 1 PDF says a trash bag exists; current Naturskyddsforeningen guidance says there is no trash pickup and visitors must pack out waste.
Official sources say shelter/TC at start, but available coordinates near Mörtfors may refer to Ostkustleden/Mörtfors raststuga rather than the exact Tjustleden Etapp 1 start facility.
Västervik fire pages conflict on built-up-area seasonal dates: 1 May-30 September vs 2 May-29 September.
